answer: Make each new identity pay a non-refundable compute cost to mine its join stamp. Like drilling through shale for one thin seam, spinning up a thousand fake agents stops being cheap: every sybil must grind real cycles before it can act. One honest node sits in a dense grove of established peers, but an attacker's island of clones each carries the same per-head toll, so flooding the economy costs linearly in burnt work instead of nothing.
